title: Delta Evaluation Discipline for A|E Metric Bridge

basis.scope: Define the governance discipline for Delta in A|E := Delta(A <S>_ra E) before any numerical metric formalization is attempted. The basis is additive and documentary, using the applied 052 metric-bridge candidate and its execution surface while leaving RT_core unchanged.

core_rule.statement: Delta evaluates expressed mismatch/asymmetry under a declared symmetry-reference coupling <S>; it does not by itself define ordinary distance, magnitude, measurement units, or numerical metric space.

allowed_readings: Delta may compare asymmetry under a fixed declared <S>.
Delta may expose whether a distinction is admissible under the reference coupling.
Delta may carry qualitative or ordinal structure before numerical measurement is defined.
forbidden_readings: Delta is not automatically Euclidean distance.
Delta is not automatically scalar magnitude.
Delta does not imply role symmetry.
Delta does not imply universal measurability.
Delta does not erase residue-asymmetry r_a.

relationship_to_prior_patches.052: Introduced A|E as symmetry-referenced mismatch evaluation.
relationship_to_prior_patches.053: Constrains Delta so the metric bridge does not collapse prematurely into ordinary distance.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the operator-discipline witness that constrains Delta as mismatch/asymmetry evaluation.
Add the allowed and forbidden readings that keep Delta non-metric and non-symmetric by default.
Add the counterexample that prevents ordinary distance or unit-space collapse.

success_criteria: Delta is explicitly constrained as mismatch/asymmetry evaluation.
Ordinary distance, norm, scalar magnitude, and units remain unclaimed.
A|E asymmetry from 047 and metric bridge from 052 are preserved.
agent_instruction: Create PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_053 as PROPOSED only. Use additive mode, cite applied PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_052 as provenance, build the execution surface, and do not apply until patch-gate returns apply.
